items.title: Cloudflare Turns CI Pipelines into TypeScript Workflows
items.blurb: Cloudflare has released cloudflare/ci, a CI SDK that defines pipelines in TypeScript on top of Cloudflare Workflows, giving each step durable retries and replay, concurrent steps by default and Sandbox snapshot caching.

items.title: shadcn Brings Conversational Primitives to shadcn/ui with New Chat Components
items.blurb: Shadcn, a design engineer at Vercel, has introduced new components for chat interfaces within the shadcn/ui project. This release includes components like MessageScroller and Message, focusing on conversation functionality.

items.title: Grafana's gcx and MCP Server Reach GA for Telemetry-Driven Agent Development
items.blurb: Grafana Labs has announced general availability for two tools that let AI coding agents query live observability data during development: the gcx CLI and the Grafana MCP server.

items.title: Java News Roundup: Simple JSON API, GlassFish, Jakarta EE, JNoSQL, Open Liberty, LangChain4j
items.blurb: This week's Java roundup for August 10th, 2026, features news highlighting: Simple JSON API proposed to target for JDK 28; an update on Jakarta EE 12; the August 2026 edition of Open Liberty; a point release of LangChain4j; maintenance…

items.title: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports MariaDB 12.3
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon RDS for MariaDB supports MariaDB major version 12.3, the latest Long-Term Support release from the MariaDB community. This release supports MariaDB 12.3.2 minor version.

items.title: AWS Marketplace now supports category-based notification subscriptions and multi-channel delivery for buyers
items.blurb: AWS Marketplace buyers can now configure category-based notifications and multi-channel delivery through AWS User Notifications.

items.title: AWS Identity and Access Management streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users with account access manager
items.blurb: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) launched account access manager, a feature that streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users.

items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports up to 10,000 collections per collection group
items.blurb: The next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports up to 10,000 collections within a single collection group, increased from the previous limit of 1,500.
